name: immigration-filing-drafter
description: Immigration Filing & Status Update Drafting Skill — Claude Desktop plugin that drafts filing narrative sections and client status-update emails from attorney-supplied case facts and the firm's own templates, for solo and small immigration-practice attorneys

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run pack && npm run checksum
scripts.release: npm run build && gh release create v$npm_package_version $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip $npm_package_name-v$npm_package_version.zip.sha256 --title "v$npm_package_version" --notes-file RELEASE.md
